items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Sinister is the biggest Barnum and Bailey Shore I ever saw in my life.

ctx.x: I don't visit those places, but I'm a lonely, I'm a lonely man, see? And I've been eating at Holmes' cafeteria because I can drive my car up in there and if I stay more than an hour, I don't have to pay any money. Otherwise, I'll have to go all over the district for a place to park and when I get in my car, somebody will hit me on the head and around me, you know? So, I don't find a food man. I can eat. I eat in the Pontchartrain too. But when they charge you a dollar and eighty cents for an armlet, that's time…
